facts.text: The registry maps the Agilent PSA models E4440A, E4443A, E4445A, E4447A, E4446A and E4448A to AgilentE44nn
AgilentE44nn wraps a pyvisa instrument: __init__ stores it in self.inst, sets the read and write termination to a newline and calls __post__
The upstream loader opens the VISA resource and passes it to the driver class: driver(self.rm.open_resource(instrument.Resource))
frequency_center reads :FREQuency:CENT? and writes :FREQuency:CENT; frequency_span reads :FREQuency:SPAN? and writes :FREQuency:SPAN
The trace's frequency axis is labelled 'Frequency (Hz)' and is built from frequency_start, frequency_stop and sweep_points
sweep_points reads :SWEep:POINts? and writes :SWEep:POINts as a whole number; the class's comment gives the E4440A range 101 to 8192 points, and 2 to 8192 in zero span
resolution_bandwidth reads :BANDwidth:RESolution? and writes it with the setter's unit keyword, which states 'Hz'
continuous reads :INIT:CONTinuous? through query_bool and writes it as a boolean
The README's manual driver demo opens GPIB0::18::INSTR with pyvisa and passes the resource to AgilentE44nn
The README sets frequency_center to 1e9, frequency_span to 10e6 and sweep_points to 8192 in its demo
The trace data is read as binary values after FORM:DATA REAL,32 and FORM:BORD SWAP, by TRAC:DATA? TRACE1
The README returns the trace as a DataFrame of the trace data
